invariants.rationale: The method always constructs and returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata instance, so result is never null.
Before returning, setWriteStatuses is called with a HoodieListData object, so getWriteStatuses() cannot be null.
The method directly dereferences clusteringPlan, so at method exit it must not be null.
schema is a parameter, and would likely result in NullPointerException if null was passed; the code expects it non-null.
instantTime is passed to methods without null checking, so at this point it cannot be null without error.
